$comment: Cross-SDK route-planner conformance vectors (#243). Each case is a complete RoutePlannerInput and the exact RoutePlan the shared Rust planner must produce for it, messages included. The planner is one Rust crate, so every platform must get byte-identical plans; these vectors prove that the SDKs hand it the same input shape and read the same output back. Run by rust/inderun-route-core/src/tests.rs (natively), packages/inderun-route-core-wasm/test/conformance.mjs (WASM), ios/IndeRun/Tests/IndeRunTests/RoutePlannerConformanceTests.swift (FFI) and android/inderun-core/src/test/kotlin/app/independo/inderun/core/SharedCoreRoutePlannerConformanceTest.kt (JNI); packages/contracts/src/routing-conformance.test.ts validates every input and plan against the schemas. When planner behaviour changes deliberately, regenerate 'expected' from the planner and review the diff.

reasons.message: Provider 'speech_only_local' does not support streaming (Mode 2) for task 'text_to_text'.
